# Alexander Maiso (Alex)

> Alexander Maiso, also known as Alex, is a Computer Engineer and Full-Stack Developer from the Philippines. He specializes in React, Next.js, Laravel, WordPress, Node.js, Python, IoT (ESP32, Arduino), and AI development.

Alexander Maiso is a versatile software developer and computer engineer based in the Philippines. He builds modern web applications, mobile apps, IoT systems, and WordPress websites for clients worldwide. He has worked with international clients including companies in Canada and the United States. His portfolio includes e-commerce platforms, learning management systems, IoT devices, mobile apps, and enterprise websites.
